fusions.name: Driven to the Head
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. A hammering blow drives a spike into the target, dealing 24 damage, leaving it [Pinned] for 2 seconds and [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Level the Ground
fusions.desc: Slams a ring of spikes into the ground around you, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and knocking each back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Tempered Edge
fusions.desc: Takes 1 second to hammer your spines to an edge, then increases your damage by 25% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Nailed Down
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, a ward absorbs 20% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
